title: NextAuth.js / Auth.js
definition: The industry-standard, open-source authentication library specifically built for Next.js, providing built-in support for OAuth providers (Google, GitHub), Magic Links, and Credentials.
simpleExplanation: Building a secure login system from scratch takes weeks and is prone to massive security vulnerabilities. NextAuth is a pre-built solution. You give it your Google API keys, and it handles the entire OAuth handshake, cookie management, and session validation in about 10 lines of code.
realWorldExample: Adding a 'Sign in with GitHub' button to your developer portfolio site in 5 minutes.

basic: What is the primary benefit of using NextAuth over building your own auth system?
intermediate: Does NextAuth manage user passwords by default?

answers.question: Primary benefit?
answers.answer: Security and speed. It handles extremely complex OAuth flows, secure cookie creation, and JWT encryption securely out of the box.

answers.question: Manage passwords?
answers.answer: No. NextAuth heavily discourages 'Credentials' (usernames and passwords) due to the immense security risks of storing passwords. It pushes developers towards OAuth (Google/GitHub) or Passwordless Magic Links.
